LanguageData.DeltaV_CargoStorageModeDesc: Available after hacking. When enabled, colonists haul allowed items into the bay and can use its contents for hauling and production. When disabled, cargo stays sealed.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeChanged: Trade cancelled: the docking link, cargo or terminal changed. Reopen trade to refresh the goods.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoRoom: Trade cancelled: stock or unlocked delivery cargo capacity is full. Free space and try again.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeConfigureDesc: Choose a trader type and restock interval, and bind supply and collection cargo bays.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeConfigureHelp: Supply bays must be locked; the collection bay must be unlocked. Lock bays with their God Mode command. Non-player stations restock periodically; use God Mode for manual restocking while building a station. Collection cargo is never refreshed.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeBindings: Cargo bindings (multiple supply bays, one collection bay)
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoKind: No valid trader type is configured.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoSupply: Bind at least one locked supply bay on this structure.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoDelivery: Bind one unlocked collection bay on this structure.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoDock: No soft docking connection to a player ship. Terminal configuration is still available.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeCargoDisconnected: The cargo bay must be on the terminal's connected substructure.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeDeliveryNeedsUnlock: Unlock this bay before assigning it for collection.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeSupplyNeedsLock: Lock this bay with its God Mode command before assigning it for supply.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeCargoAlreadyBound: This bay belongs to another terminal. Remove its previous binding first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoCargoOnMap: There are no cargo bays on this map.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DevTradeRestock: DEV: Regenerate supply stock (replaces old stock)
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeCloseWindow: Close the trade window before regenerating stock.
